qe: Mustafa Khan, whose body was cut in two and half of it hung at each of the two gates of old Patna's wall, was a rebellious general of which Nawab?
qh: पुराने पटना की दीवार के दोनों दरवाज़ों पर जिसका शरीर दो टुकड़ों में लटकाया गया था, वह मुस्तफा खान किस नवाब का विद्रोही सेनापति था?
e: Purane Patna ki deewar ke purabi tatha pashchimi darwaze ab bhi patthar ke nishanon se pehchane jaate hain. Us daur me jab koi bada vidrohi senapati pakda jaata ya maara jaata, to uske shareer ke do tukde kar ke ek tukda ek darwaze par tatha doosra doosre darwaze par latka diya jaata tha, taaki sab log dekh kar darr jaayein. Mustafa Khan Alivardi Khan ka vidrohi senapati tha; uske maare jaane par usi tarah uske shareer ke do tukde kar ke dono darwazon par latka diye gaye the. Kai saal baad, 1748 me Zain-ud-din ki Afghan logon dwara hatya ke baad uske saath bhi aisa hi kiya gaya. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki 18vein sadi ke Patna me shahar ki deewar sirf suraksha ka sadhan nahi thi, balki satta tatha darr dikhane ka sthal bhi thi. Exam point: vidrohi senapati Mustafa Khan ke shareer ke do tukde Patna ki deewar ke dono darwazon par latkaye gaye the tatha 1748 me Zain-ud-din ke saath bhi aisa hi hua; Mustafa Khan Alivardi Khan ka vidrohi senapati tha.

qe: Of the four great towers at the corners of Patna's old city wall, the one strengthened in 1763 to command the neighbouring English factory was demolished in which year?
qh: पटना की पुरानी शहरपनाह के चारों कोनों के बड़े बुर्जों में, जिसे 1763 में पास की अंग्रेज फैक्ट्री पर नियंत्रण के लिए मज़बूत किया गया था, वह किस वर्ष गिरा दिया गया?
e: Purane Patna ki deewar ke chaar kono par chaar bade burj the. Unme se teen burj aaj bhi bache hue hain - ek kila ke purab me Ganga ke kinare, doosra Patna City railway station ke kareeb tatha teesra Gulzarbagh railway station ke purab me. Chautha burj, jo 1763 me angreji factory par nazar rakhne ke liye mazboot kiya gaya tha, 1857 ke vidroh ke dauran gira diya gaya tatha ab maujood nahi hai. Is tarah Patna ki purani suraksha-vyavastha ke nishaan dhire-dhire mit gaye; aaj bhi purani deewar ki line zameen par aasani se pehchani ja sakti hai. Aisi jankari dikhati hai ki 18vein tatha 19vein sadi me shahar ki raksha deewar, khai tatha burjon par nirbhar thi, isliye jab yeh vyavastha kamzor padi to shahar bahari hamlon ke liye khula ho gaya. Exam point: Patna ki purani deewar ke chaar kono ke burjon me teen aaj bhi maujood hain; 1763 me angreji factory ke liye mazboot kiya gaya chautha burj 1857 me gira diya gaya; purani deewar ki line aaj bhi pehchani ja sakti hai.

qe: How many of the great towers that stood at the four corners of Patna's old city wall still exist?
qh: पटना की पुरानी शहरपनाह के चारों कोनों पर खड़े बड़े बुर्जों में से कितने आज भी मौजूद हैं?
e: Patna ki purani deewar mukhya roop se mitti ki thi, isliye use baar-baar marammat ki zarurat padti thi. Deewar ke chaar kono par chaar bade burj the, jinse shahar ki raksha hoti thi. Aaj unme se teen burj bache hue hain: ek kila ke purab me Ganga ke kinare, doosra Patna City railway station ke kareeb tatha teesra Gulzarbagh railway station ke purab me. Chauthe burj ko, jo 1763 me angreji factory par nazar rakhne ke liye mazboot kiya gaya tha, 1857 me gira diya gaya. Zain-ud-din ne deewar ke chaaron taraf gehri khai khudwai tatha mitti se deewar ko oonchi tatha mazboot karwaya; Maratha hamlon ke samay log isi deewar ke andar panah lete the tatha bahar ke ghar bhi burjon ki topon se surakshit rahte the. 1772 me deewar ek baar phir marammat karai gayi, kintu uske baad use dhyan nahi diya gaya. Exam point: Patna ki purani deewar ke chaar kono ke burjon me se teen aaj bhi maujood hain; yah deewar mukhya roop se mitti ki thi tatha Maratha hamlon ke samay log isi ke andar panah lete the; 1763 me mazboot chautha burj 1857 me gir gaya.

qe: The beehive-shaped granary at Bankipore, with two staircases on the outside winding to the top, stands how high?
qh: बांकीपुर का मधुमक्खी-छत्ते जैसा अनाज-भंडार, जिसकी बाहर दो सीढ़ियाँ घूमती हुई ऊपर तक जाती हैं, कितना ऊँचा है?
e: Bankipore ka gola yaani Golghar ek madhumakkhi ke chhatte jaisa bada anaj-bhandar hai, jise 1786 me John Garstin ne banwaya tha. Iski unchai 96 feet hai tatha neeche ki taraf iski deewarein 12 feet moti hain; bahar do seedhiyan ghoomti hui chhat tak jaati hain, jahan se Ganga tatha poore shahar ka sundar nazara dikhta hai. Is imarat ki ek khaas baat uske andar ka goonjta hua echo hai, isliye yahan aawaz kai baar laut kar sunai deti hai. Golghar banane ka uddeshya 1770 ki bhayankar akal jaisi vipatti me anaj ka bada bhandar rakhna tha, taaki aage kisi akal me log bhookh se na marein; isliye ise akal tatha bhookh se bachaav ki soch ka prateek maana jaata hai. Exam point: Golghar ki unchai 96 feet tatha neeche ki deewaron ki motai 12 feet hai; bahar do ghoomti hui seedhiyan hain; yah 1786 me John Garstin dwara Bankipore me anaj-bhandar ke roop me banaya gaya.

qe: The scheme for building a number of granaries, to be kept filled in anticipation of scarcity, was put forward in 1783 by which officer?
qh: अकाल की आशंका में भरे रखने योग्य अनेक अनाज-भंडार बनाने की योजना 1783 में किस अफसर ने रखी थी?
e: 1783 me Patna kshetra me akal ka bhay phir se jaga, kyunki 1770 ki bhayankar akal ki yaadein logon ke zehen me taaza thi. Us saal John Shore Patna se Calcutta wapas ja rahe the, to unhone ek yojna rakhi ki kai bade anaj-bhandar (granaries) banaye jaayein tatha unhe akal ki ashanka ke samay bhara rakha jaaye. Isi soch se 1786 me Bankipore me bada gola yaani Golghar banaya gaya, jispar yah bhi likha gaya ki yah bhookh ko hamesha ke liye rokne ke liye banwaya gaya hai. Lekin bhandar ban jane ke baad usme kabhi anaj nahi bhara gaya tatha aisi aur granaries bhi nahi banai gayin, isliye Golghar 1783 ki is tanqidi tatha 1770 ki akal ke bhaye ka yaadgar ban kar rah gaya. John Garstin ne 1786 me Golghar banwaya tha, Warren Hastings us daur ke Governor-General the tatha William Tayler 1857 me Patna ke Commissioner the. Exam point: anaj-bhandaron yaani granaries ki yojna 1783 me John Shore ne rakhi; Golghar 1786 me banwaya gaya, kintu usme anaj kabhi bhara nahi gaya tatha aisi aur granaries nahi banai gayin.

qe: The famous mutiny of officers at the Bankipore cantonments in 1766 was occasioned by discontent at the abolition of what?
qh: 1766 में बांकीपुर छावनी में अफसरों का प्रसिद्ध विद्रोह किस चीज़ को समाप्त किए जाने से हुए असंतोष के कारण हुआ था?
e: 1765 me Clive ke nirdesh par Ganga ke kinare Bankipore me Third Brigade ki nayi chhawni banai gayi. Agle varsh 1766 me isi chhawni me angreji afsaron ka prasiddh vidroh hua, jiska mukhya karan 'double batta' yaani yuddh ke samay milne wala dohra bhatta khatm kar diya jaana tha. Is faisle se naraz hokar bahut se afsar apne commission chhodne ki dhamki dene lage tatha vidroh ke dauran chhawni ke kai bungalow jal bhi gaye; jaanch me pata chala ki aag ek jhagde me palat gaye lamp se lagi thi, jo ek aise afsar se hua kar raha tha jo apna commission wapas karne ko taiyar nahi tha. Afsaron ne ek saath apne commission chhod diye, lekin Brigade ke commandar Sir Robert Barker ke prabhav se unhe apni duty chhodne se rok liya gaya tatha 20 May ko Clive Bankipore pahunche, tab unhone aagya maan li. Exam point: Bankipore ki chhawni 1765 me Clive ke nirdesh par bani; 1766 ka afsar-vidroh double batta khatm hone ke viruddh tha; Sir Robert Barker ne afsaron ko kaabu me rakha tatha 20 May ko Clive ke aane par sab ne aagya maan li.

qe: The old cantonments of the Third Brigade on the river-front at Bankipore were built in 1765 under whose directions?
qh: बांकीपुर में गंगा-तट पर तीसरी ब्रिगेड की पुरानी छावनी 1765 में किसके निर्देश पर बनाई गई थी?
e: 1765 me Clive ke nirdesh par Bankipore me Ganga ke kinare Third Brigade ki chhawni banai gayi. Yah wahi saal tha jab Buxar ki vijay ke baad angrejon ne Bengal, Bihar tatha Orissa ki diwani hasil ki tatha Bankipore Patna kshetra me unka pramukh chhawni tatha prashasanik kendra ban gaya. Isi chhawni tatha Company ki factory ki zaruraton ke liye paas me ek bazaar basa, jise Barkerganj kaha gaya, jisse Patna ke pashchimi ilaake ka bahut vikas hua. Kuch samay baad Brigade ko Dinapore sthalantarit kar diya gaya, lekin Bankipore ka paschim ki taraf phailav jaari raha. Sir Robert Barker is brigade ke commandar the tatha Hector Munro ne Buxar ki ladai ladi thi. Exam point: Bankipore ki Third Brigade chhawni 1765 me Clive ke nirdesh par bani; isi saal 1765 me Bengal, Bihar tatha Orissa ki diwani mili thi; chhawni ki zarurat se Barkerganj bazaar bana tatha aage Brigade Dinapore chali gayi.

qe: Which bazar, grown to serve the needs of the Brigade at Bankipore and leading to the development of Patna's western suburbs, is named after the officer commanding that Brigade?
qh: बांकीपुर की ब्रिगेड की ज़रूरतें पूरी करने के लिए बसा तथा पटना के पश्चिमी उपनगरों के विकास का कारण बना कौन-सा बाज़ार उस ब्रिगेड के कमांडर अफसर के नाम पर है?
e: Bankipore me Third Brigade ki chhawni ban jane ke baad wahan rahne wale sipahiyon tatha afsaron ki zaruraton ke liye paas me ek bazaar basa, jise Brigade ke commandar Sir Robert Barker ke naam par Barkerganj kaha gaya. Is bazaar tatha Bankipore me East India Company ki factory ke aane se Patna ke pashchimi ilaake ka bahut vikas hua; Bankipore se Digha tatha Sherpur se Gulzarbagh tak lambe raste baste gaye, chahe in raston ke beech kai jagah jungle tatha khet bhi bache rahe. Isi tarah 1741 tak shahar purani deewar se bahar bhi phail chuka tha tatha bade logon ke bagh-ghar Bankipore tak Ganga ke kinare ban gaye the. Gulzarbagh, Alamganj tatha Kumrahar Patna ke anya purane ilake hain, jin ke naam is brigade ke commandar se nahi jude. Exam point: Barkerganj bazaar ka naam Third Brigade ke commandar Sir Robert Barker se juda hai; Bankipore me Company ki factory tatha brigade ke kaaran Patna ka pashchimi kshetra bahut phaila; 1741 tak shahar purani deewar ke bahar bhi phail chuka tha.

qe: By 1741 the city of Patna had spread beyond its walls, and the East India Company had a garden on the Ganges at Bankipore known as?
qh: 1741 तक पटना नगर अपनी शहरपनाह से बाहर भी फैल चुका था तथा बांकीपुर में गंगा के किनारे ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी का एक बाग़ था, जो किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
e: 1741 tak Patna ka shahar apni purani deewar ke bahar bhi phail chuka tha. Bade logon ne apne bagh-ghar Ganga ke kinare Bankipore tak banwa liye the, tatha Bankipore me Ganga ke kinare East India Company ka ek bagh tha, jise Company Bagh kaha jaata tha. Aage chal kar Company ne apni factory isi bagh ke paas, thoda pashchim ki taraf, sthalantarit kar di tatha wahan ek bazaar bas gaya, jisse Bankipore ka kshetra kaafi viksit ho gaya; Brigade ke Dinapore chale jaane ke baad bhi yah phailav jaari raha. Chajju Bagh ka sambandh 1857 ke vidroh se hai, jab wah Commissioner William Tayler ka nivas tha tatha wahan European nivasi suraksha ke liye ikattha hue the; Gulzarbagh tatha Kumrahar Patna ke anya purane sthal hain, isliye yah vikalp is bagh ka naam nahi hai. Exam point: 1741 tak Patna shahar deewar ke bahar phail chuka tha; Bankipore me Ganga ke kinare East India Company ka bagh Company Bagh kehlata tha; aage factory usi ke paas sthalantarit hui tatha Bankipore ka kshetra viksit hua.
